recognize_zh: 肋膜積液細胞塊中漂浮成團的大型漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic/immunoblastic）細胞，核仁明顯、細胞質雙染性，且無實體腫塊；同一病人皮膚有 Kaposi sarcoma 的紫紅結節與梭形細胞增生，病灶細胞呈 HHV8 LANA-1 顆粒狀核染色，指向 HIV 相關的原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Effusion cell block: discohesive clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells floating in fibrinous/proteinaceous background
Large cells with round to irregular vesicular nuclei, prominent central nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmablastic/immunoblastic)
Admixed small reactive lymphocytes that remain negative on the tumor-cell markers
Tumor cells show strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining with one marker and nuclear staining (including a speckled, LANA-1-like pattern) with others; one marker is negative with heavy background
Skin biopsy: dermal spindle cell proliferation with slit-like vascular spaces, extravasated red cells and nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 positivity (Kaposi sarcoma)
Clinical photo: multiple violaceous macules/nodules on the scalp
describe_en: Pleural fluid cell block sections show clusters of large, discohesive neoplastic lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, set in a fibrinous background with scattered small lymphocytes. Immunostains demonstrate strong membranous/cytoplasmic positivity of the large cells for one marker, nuclear positivity for others including a granular LANA-1-type pattern, and negativity for a marker that shows only background staining; the specific antibodies are not labeled on the images. A concurrent skin biopsy shows a dermal spindle cell proliferation with slit-like vascular channels and nuclear HHV8 LANA-1 expression, corresponding to the violaceous scalp nodules. In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with HHV8+/EBV+ primary effusion lymphoma with concurrent Kaposi sarcoma.

ddx.dx: Extracavitary/solid variant PEL or HHV8+ DLBCL, NOS
ddx.vs: PEL here is confined to the effusion without a solid mass, whereas HHV8+ DLBCL arises in lymph nodes/spleen, is usually EBV-negative and often expresses IgM lambda.
Plasmablastic lymphoma usually forms solid (often oral/GI) masses and is EBV+ but HHV8 LANA-1 negative.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV8-negative effusion-based lymphoma)
ddx.vs: It occurs in elderly HIV-negative patients, usually retains CD20 and is HHV8-negative, unlike the LANA-1+ null-phenotype cells of PEL.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or mesothelial cells in effusion
ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive 3D clusters with keratin positivity, whereas PEL cells are discohesive, keratin-negative and express CD138/MUM1 with HHV8 LANA-1.
